def fixdir(ins, d):
    # ensure drop is in direction d relative to inserter
    dp = ins.drop_position; p = ins.position
    ok = (d == Direction.DOWN and dp.y > p.y) or (d == Direction.UP and dp.y < p.y) or (d == Direction.RIGHT and dp.x > p.x) or (d == Direction.LEFT and dp.x < p.x)
    if not ok:
        ins = rotate_entity(ins, d)
    print('ins', ins.position, 'pick', ins.pickup_position, 'drop', ins.drop_position)
    return ins
